Peter is scared of being the next iron man, but the writers didn’t even know what Iron Man did. Far from home was definitely made to ride the hype of the Avengers movie, and for that they definitely succeeded, at least in the box office. They also use the blip as a joke, which wasn’t awful but still felt like they didn’t understand how serious that really is. It’s also the reason why Captain America and Black Widow are never even mentioned in this movie other than the very beginning, which was probably added after Endgame released.
